how_to_read.cells: every 16x16 room cell touching the 240x160 view; ground is BG2 (opaque), overlay BG1 (index 0 transparent, drawn over sprites of priority 2)
how_to_read.frame_shown: the animation frame on screen in the bg capture: (frame counter // frame_duration_60ths) % frames
how_to_read.hardware: the 8x8 screen entries actually in VRAM for the 31x21 tiles covering the view, from first_tile, scrolled by scroll_px
how_to_read.bg_palette_ram: the 16 BG banks as the hardware holds them (BGR555, shown as 8-bit RGB the way mGBA expands them)
how_to_read.sprites: OAM entries on screen in the full capture; priority 2 draws over BG2 and under BG1

objects: OBJ_SPAWN (12,15), OBJ_EXIT the hole (9,1), OBJ_NPC the Gatekeeper (21,4), OBJ_SHOP the Peddler (4,4)
